# Lucent styles (vendored)

A copy of the CSS from [Lucent](https://github.com/Design-Foundry/lucent), the Design Foundry
design system, licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`).

- Version: 0.5.0, commit `822170e` of `styles/`.
- Included: `core.css`, `packs/messaging.css`, and the `tokens/` and `components/` files they
  import. Components outside core and the messaging pack are left out.
- Not modified. To update, copy the same files again from a newer Lucent and change the version
  above.
